what: The store's shipping policy and contact information policy as they are (`before`) and as the gallery's answers of 2026-10-01 make them (`after`), read through the Shopify connector (shop.shopPolicies). NOT WRITTEN: neither the connector nor the CLI's store access may write policies (`write_legal_policies`). Michael makes the two changes in the admin, Settings, Policies.

policies.before:
UNFRAMED Prints

  • In-store pickup*: Free
  • Shipping within Vancouver Lower Mainland, British Columbia, and Canada: $20

    Orders are typically prepared and shipped within 3–5 business days.
    Delivery times may vary depending on location and carrier.
    *2121 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver, BC

FRAMED Prints

  • Framed prints are available for in-store pickup only**
  • Please allow 2–3 weeks for framing and preparation.
  • You will be contacted once your order is ready.

    **Courier delivery can be arranged at the customer’s expense

Additional Information

  • We are not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers or circumstances beyond our control.
  • Please ensure your shipping information is accurate at checkout.
  • Unframed prints will be shipped within 3-5 business days. Shipping will be calculated and confirmed with you at the time of the order.
  • We offer free in-store pickup. Please allow 1-2 business days for handling.
    We will contact you once your print is ready for pick up.
